#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

class MetroSolver {
private:
    int n, m, s;
    long long t;

    void advance() {
        int jump = (int)(t % n);
        t--;
        int dir = (s < m) ? 1 : -1;
        s = ((s + dir * jump) % n + n) % n;
    }

    void advanceCycle() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) advance();
    }

public:
    void solve() {
        cin >> n >> m >> s >> t;
        s--; // convert to 0-indexed

        // First phase: reduce t to multiple of n
        while (t % n != 0) advance();

        // Cycle detection phase
        vector<long long> memory(n, -1);
        while (t != 0) {
            advanceCycle();
            if (memory[s] != -1) {
                long long interval = memory[s] - t;
                t %= interval;
                break;
            }
            memory[s] = t;
        }

        // Finish remaining steps
        while (t != 0) advance();

        cout << (s + 1) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    MetroSolver solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
